title: DataDetPlcySstvDataCatg - Data API
description: Represents the sensitive data categories that the DataDetect scan policy is required to scan. This object is available in API version 64.0 and later.

DataCategory.description: Sensitive data category associated with the scan policy.

DataDetectPolicyId.description: ID of the scan policy associated with the sensitive data category. This field is a relationship field.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: Name of the sensitive data category.
